mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dcr_tree( dcr01_class_tree_id, dcr01_company_id, dcr01_class_tree_nm, dcr01_parent_tree_id, dcr01_seq, dcr01_class_tree_cd, dcr01_type_cd, depth, path, cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, 1, ARRAY[CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')], false FROM dcr01_class_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = 0 AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE '%' UNION ALL SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id, a.dcr01_company_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_seq, a.dcr01_class_tree_cd, a.dcr01_type_cd, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, CAST(a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS varchar) || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_seq AS varchar),10,'0') || a.dcr01_class_tree_cd || LPAD(CAST(a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS varchar),15,'0')), a.dcr01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM dcr01_class_tree a INNER JOIN dcr_tree b ON a.dcr01_parent_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr01_type_cd LIKE '%' AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, a.dcr01_parent_tree_id AS parent_tree_id, a.dcr01_class_tree_nm || ' (' || COALESCE((WITH RECURSIVE child_tree AS ( SELECT dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = a.dcr01_class_tree_id UNION ALL SELECT t.dcr01_class_tree_id FROM dcr_tree t INNER JOIN child_tree ct ON t.dcr01_parent_tree_id = ct.dcr01_class_tree_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_tree c JOIN dcr40_stamp_auth s ON s.dcr40_class_tree_id = c.dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE s.dcr40_stamp_id = #{stampId} AND s.dcr40_except_yn = 'true' ), 0) || ')' AS class_tree_name, a.dcr01_type_cd AS type_code, COALESCE((SELECT dcr40_except_yn FROM dcr40_stamp_auth WHERE dcr40_class_tree_id = a.dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr40_stamp_id = #{stampId} LIMIT 1), 'false') AS stamp_except_yn, a.depth - 1 AS depth FROM dcr_tree a WHERE a.dcr01_type_cd IN ('T','C') ORDER BY a.path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcr40_stamp_auth (dcr40_stamp_auth_id, dcr40_stamp_id, dcr40_class_tree_id, dcr40_except_yn) VALUES (#{stampAuthId}, #{stampId}, #{classTreeId}, #{exceptYn})
